def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    def P(r,c):
        return [(r,w-1-c),(h-1-r,c),(h-1-r,w-1-c),(c,r),(w-1-c,h-1-r)]
    def broken(p):
        r,c=p
        return any(grid[r][c]!=grid[q[0]][q[1]] for q in P(r,c) if (r,c)!=(q[0],q[1]) and (q[0],q[1])!=(r,c))
    # noise cells: those whose orbit is inconsistent with them
    noise={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if len({grid[p[0]][p[1]] for p in P(r,c)})>1 or
              sum(1 for p in P(r,c) if grid[p[0]][p[1]]!=grid[r][c])>=2}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in noise:
        vals=[grid[p[0]][p[1]] for p in P(r,c) if p not in noise]
        if vals: out[r][c]=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
